files.patch:
@@ -0,0 +1,237 @@ +--- +title: Jais 3 +description: "Deploy the IFM Jais 3 family with SGLang — BF16 recipes for six dense and Mixture-of-Experts checkpoints on NVIDIA H100 GPUs." +tag: NEW +--- + +## Deployment + + + + + +Jais 3 is supported from SGLang 0.5.20: + +```bash Command +pip install --upgrade pip +pip install "sglang>=0.5.20" +``` + +For other install methods, see [Install](/docs/get-started/install). + + + +Choose a model size to generate its H100 launch command. Five checkpoints run on a single node; 375B-A23B needs two. The recipes serve each repository's `main` branch. + +import { Deployment } from "/src/snippets/_deployment.jsx"; +import { config } from "/src/snippets/configs/IFM/jais-3.jsx"; +import { benchmarks } from "/src/snippets/configs/IFM/jais-3-benchmarks.jsx"; + + + +Each accuracy value in the benchmark cards is the arithmetic mean of two full evaluation runs. Speed values come from a single run. + +## Playground + +The base recipes enable the `k2_horizon` reasoning parser. Use the Playground to configure the `k2_horizon` tool-call parser, TP and MoE expert-parallel overrides, NGRAM speculative decoding, PD disaggregation, and HiCache. A separate validation pass functionally exercised the tool-call parser on all six checkpoints; every other Playground override remains unverified. + +import { Playground } from "/src/snippets/_playground.jsx"; + + + +## 1. Model introduction + +**Jais 3** is an IFM model family spanning six checkpoints from **0.9B** to **375B** parameters. The family includes dense models, Mixture-of-Experts models, and the MoVA-36B-A4B checkpoint's routed Mixture-of-Value-Attention path. This page provides native SGLang serving recipes for the family. + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + + +
CheckpointArchitectureContext lengthH100 recipe
0.9BDense131,072BF16 · TP1
3.7BDense524,288BF16 · TP1
7BDense524,288BF16 · TP1
32BDense524,288BF16 · TP2
MoVA-36B-A4BMoE + MoVA524,288BF16 · TP2 · EP2
375B-A23BMoE524,288BF16 · TP16 · EP16 · 2 nodes
+ +**Resources:** [Jais 3 collection](https://huggingface.co/collections/IFM/jais-3) · [Jais 3 375B-A23B model card](https://huggingface.co/IFM/Jais-3-375B-A23B). + +## 2. Configuration tips + +- **Hardware and precision:** The current matrix covers NVIDIA H100 GPUs and BF16 checkpoints only. +- **Parallelism:** Use TP1 for 0.9B, 3.7B, and 7B; TP2 for 32B; TP2 with expert parallelism (`--ep 2`) for MoVA-36B-A4B; and TP16 with `--ep 16` across two eight-GPU nodes for 375B-A23B. Every other recipe stays within one node. +- **Attention:** The verified base recipes select FlashAttention-3 with `--attention-backend fa3`. +- **Parsers:** The base recipes enable reasoning with `--reasoning-parser k2_horizon`. Enable `--tool-call-parser k2_horizon` from the **Parsers** card in the [Playground](#playground) when you need tool calling. +- **MoVA-36B-A4B router provenance:** The MoVA-36B-A4B checkpoint's source xLLM router used two GEMM partitions. `--json-model-override-args '{"xllm_source_router_gemm_partitions":2}'` preserves its BF16 partial-GEMM rounding and FP32 reduction order; SGLang does not infer this source topology from runtime TP. +- **375B-A23B memory:** The BF16 weights take about 760 GB. One node of eight H100 80 GB GPUs holds 640 GB, so the checkpoint does not fit on a single node; the recipe uses two nodes (16 GPUs, 1,280 GB). Run the generated command on both nodes, with node rank 0 on the head node and 1 on the other. +- **375B-A23B loading:** The 375B-A23B recipe disables multithreaded weight loading with `--model-loader-extra-config '{"enable_multithread_load":false}'`. +- **Playground features:** TP and EP settings other than the base recipes', NGRAM, PD disaggregation, and HiCache are optional, unverified command overrides. The tool-call parser was functionally exercised separately. +- **Deliberate omissions:** Context parallelism is unsupported or unvalidated for xLLM. DP-attention and alternate MoE backend selectors are not exposed until they are validated. +- **Validation:** All six recipes completed two full GSM8K evaluation runs on H100; see [Benchmark results](#3-benchmark-results). + +## 3. Benchmark results + +Speed was measured with native `sglang.benchmark.serving` using fixed random token IDs: 8,192 input tokens, 1,024 output tokens, 64 warmup requests, a cache flush, and seed `20260901`. The latency run uses 32 prompts at concurrency 1. The throughput run uses 256 prompts at concurrency 64 for the single-GPU checkpoints, 32 for the two-GPU checkpoints, and 8 for the two-node 375B-A23B. Each speed value comes from a single run, with the load generator on a separate client node; TTFT and TPOT are medians. Throughput per GPU is `(total input tokens + total output tokens) / duration / TP`. Checkpoints and workloads not yet measured show a dash in the benchmark cards. + +GSM8K used the full 1,319-example test split with `sgl-eval`, 32 client threads, a 32,768-token output limit, temperature 0, top-p 0.95, seed 0, and high reasoning effort. Each server ran on H100 from the repository's `main` branch, with no pinned revision. The evaluation is zero-shot: each question is sent as a single user message with the `math` prompt, which asks for the final answer inside `\boxed{}`, and no worked examples. Scoring is rule-based accuracy with no LLM judge: `sgl-eval` extracts the last `\boxed{}` from the final answer and checks it against the reference by symbolic equivalence, so `\$57{,}500` matches `57500`. A response with no boxed answer counts as incorrect, so these scores can be lower than LLM-as-a-judge results on the same outputs. + +Each checkpoint was evaluated twice, and the table shows both runs and their mean. The 0.9B and 3.7B runs were issued one after the other; from 7B onward both were issued together with `--n-repeats 2` against one running server. All requests completed without errors. Responses that reached the output limit stay in the score and count as incorrect; the Truncated column gives the share of such responses in run 1 and run 2. + +| Checkpoint | Run 1 | Run 2 | Mean | Truncated | +| --- | ---: | ---: | ---: | ---: | +| 0.9B | 83.62% | 83.78% | 83.70% | 0.68% / 0.61% | +| 3.7B | 96.36% | 96.13% | 96.25% | 0.00% / 0.15% | +| 7B | 95.91% | 95.83% | 95.87% | 0.00% / 0.08% | +| 32B | 96.51% | 96.74% | 96.63% | 0.00% / 0.00% | +| MoVA-36B-A4B | 95.98% | 96.44% | 96.21% | 0.00% / 0.00% | +| 375B-A23B | 96.44% | 96.21% | 96.32% | 0.00% / 0.00% | + +## 4. Advanced usage + +### 4.1 Reasoning + +The base recipes include `--reasoning-parser k2_horizon`. The parser returns thinking in `reasoning_content` and the final answer in `content`. + +The example output below was captured with the MoVA-36B-A4B checkpoint and both parser flags enabled. + + + +```python Example +from openai import OpenAI + +client = OpenAI(base_url="http://localhost:30000/v1", api_key="EMPTY") +response = client.chat.completions.create( + model="IFM/Jais-3-MoVA-36B-A4B", + messages=[{"role": "user", "content": "Hello"}], +) + +message = response.choices[0].message +reasoning = getattr(message, "reasoning_content", None) +if reasoning is None: + reasoning = (message.model_extra or {}).get("reasoning_content") +print("Reasoning:", reasoning) +print("Answer:", message.content) +``` + + + + + +```text Output +Reasoning: The user says "Hello". As a helpful AI, we should greet them back, maybe ask how we can assist. + +We need to respond with a friendly greeting. Probably something like "Hello! How can I help you today?" + +That's straightforward. + +We should consider any policies for greeting. No issues. + +Let's proceed. +Answer: Hello! How can I help you today? +``` + + + +### 4.2 Tool calling + +Enable **Tool Call Parser** in the **Parsers** card of the [Playground](#playground) to add `--tool-call-parser k2_horizon`. The parser exposes K2 tool output as OpenAI-compatible `message.tool_calls`. + +The example output below was captured with the MoVA-36B-A4B checkpoint and both parser flags enabled. + + + +```python Example +from openai import OpenAI + +client = OpenAI(base_url="http://localhost:30000/v1", api_key="EMPTY") +tools = [ + { + "type": "function", + "function": { + "name": "get_weather", + "description": "Return weather for a city.", + "parameters": { + "type": "object", + "properties": {"city": {"type": "string"}}, + "required": ["city"], + }, + }, + } +] + +response = client.chat.completions.create( + model="IFM/Jais-3-MoVA-36B-A4B", + messages=[{"role": "user", "content": "Call get_weather for Paris."}], + tools=tools, + tool_choice={"type": "function", "function": {"name": "get_weather"}}, + max_tokens=1024, +) + +message = response.choices[0].message +reasoning = getattr(message, "reasoning_content", None) +if reasoning is None: + reasoning = (message.model_extra or {}).get("reasoning_content") +print("Reasoning:", reasoning) +print("Content:", message.content or "") +for tool_call in message.tool_calls or []: + print(f"Tool call: {tool_call.function.name}({tool_call.function.arguments})") +``` + + + + + +```text Output +Reasoning: The user wants the weather for Paris, using the get_weather function. We'll call the function. +Content: [{"name":"get_weather", "parameters": {"city": "Paris"}}] +``` + + + +### 4.3 HiCache + +For large checkpoints or repeated long-context prefixes, enable **HiCache** in the [Playground](#playground), then choose a storage backend and write policy. Treat the generated override as unverified until it is exercised on your storage stack.

+// Single `export const config` literal — Mintlify re-evaluates this module at
+// hydration time, so keep the cookbook data self-contained.
+//
+// The base recipes below serve each repository's main branch (no pinned
+// revision) on NVIDIA H100 GPUs, using SGLang's native K2 Horizon support
+// (released in 0.5.20). Playground overrides remain separate from them.
+
+export const config = {
+  modelName: "Jais 3",
+
+  latencyPercentile: "P50",
+
+  supportedHardware: ["h100"],
+  runModes: ["python"],
+
+  variants: [
+    { id: "0.9b", label: "0.9B", subtitle: "Dense" },
+    { id: "3.7b", label: "3.7B", subtitle: "Dense" },
+    { id: "7b", label: "7B", subtitle: "Dense" },
+    { id: "32b", label: "32B", subtitle: "Dense" },
+    { id: "36b", label: "MoVA-36B-A4B", subtitle: "MoE + MoVA" },
+    { id: "375b", label: "375B-A23B", subtitle: "MoE" },
+  ],
+  quantizations: [
+    { id: "bf16", label: "BF16" },
+  ],
+  strategies: [
+    { id: "balanced", label: "Balanced" },
+  ],
+  nodesOptions: [
+    { id: "single", label: "Single Node" },
+    { id: "multi-2", label: "2 Nodes" },
+  ],
+
+  modelNames: {
+    "0.9b|bf16": "IFM/Jais-3-0.9B",
+    "3.7b|bf16": "IFM/Jais-3-3.7B",
+    "7b|bf16": "IFM/Jais-3-7B",
+    "32b|bf16": "IFM/Jais-3-32B",
+    "36b|bf16": "IFM/Jais-3-MoVA-36B-A4B",
+    "375b|bf16": "IFM/Jais-3-375B-A23B",
+  },
+
+  placeholders: {
+    HOST_IP:   { target: "command", label: "Bind host",   default: "0.0.0.0"   },
+    PORT:      { target: "command", label: "Bind port",   default: "30000"     },
+    NODE0_IP:  { target: "command", label: "Head node IP",   default: "<node0-ip>"   },
+    NODE_RANK: { target: "command", label: "This node rank", default: "<node-rank>"  },
+    CURL_HOST: { target: "curl",    label: "Server host", default: "localhost" },
+    CURL_PORT: { target: "curl",    label: "Server port", default: "30000"     },
+  },
+
+  curl: `curl http://{{CURL_HOST}}:{{CURL_PORT}}/v1/chat/completions \\
+-H 'Content-Type: application/json' \\
+-d '{ "model": "{{MODEL_NAME}}", "messages": [{"role":"user","content":"Hello"}] }'`,
+
+  benchmarkCommands: {
+    speed:
+`python3 -m sglang.benchmark.serving \\
+  --backend sglang \\
+  --base-url http://{{CURL_HOST}}:{{CURL_PORT}} \\
+  --model {{MODEL_NAME}} --served-model-name {{MODEL_NAME}} \\
+  --tokenizer {{MODEL_NAME}} \\
+  --dataset-name {{DATASET}} --tokenize-prompt \\
+  --random-input-len {{ISL}} --random-output-len {{OSL}} \\
+  --random-range-ratio 1.0 \\
+  --num-prompts {{NUM_PROMPTS}} --max-concurrency {{MAX_CONCURRENCY}} \\
+  --request-rate inf --seed 20260901 \\
+  --temperature 0.0 --top-p 1.0 \\
+  --warmup-requests 64 --flush-cache \\
+  --output-file benchmark.raw.jsonl --output-details`,
+    accuracy: {
+      gsm8k_pct:
+`pip install sgl-eval
+sgl-eval run gsm8k \\
+  --base-url http://{{CURL_HOST}}:{{CURL_PORT}}/v1 \\
+  --model {{MODEL_NAME}} \\
+  --num-examples 1319 --num-threads 32 --n-repeats 1 \\
+  --max-tokens 32768 --temperature 0.0 --top-p 0.95 \\
+  --seed 0 --reasoning-effort high --prompt math`,
